shelters.name: Richmond SPCA
shelters.description: Founded in 1891, no-kill humane organization. Rescues, treats, rehabilitates and adopts about 4,000 homeless animals yearly. Maintains transport partnerships with over 60 groups.

shelters.name: Virginia Beach SPCA
shelters.description: Partner in animal welfare in Hampton Roads since 1966. Serves over 11,000 clients annually for veterinary care. Provides shelter to approximately 3,000 homeless animals yearly.

shelters.name: Norfolk SPCA
shelters.description: One of the nation's oldest animal welfare organizations serving Hampton Roads. Rescues, rehabilitates, and rehomes pets. Operates veterinary clinic.

shelters.name: Animal Welfare League of Arlington
shelters.description: Founded in 1944, provides animal adoption and community programs to Northern Virginia and D.C. metropolitan area. Provides animal rescue and control services.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Fairfax County
shelters.description: Since 1965, helping rescue and protect animals from abuse, neglect, abandonment, and cruelty. Fosters humane treatment through education and adoptions.

shelters.name: Fairfax County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Fairfax County's official animal services organization.

shelters.name: SPCA of Northern Virginia
shelters.description: Volunteer-run, non-profit organization that rescues and finds homes for hundreds of cats and dogs each year.

shelters.name: Chesapeake Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Chesapeake and the Hampton Roads area.

shelters.name: Roanoke Valley SPCA
shelters.description: Community resource for pet adoption, retention, and education in Virginia's Blue Ridge. Since 1916, nonprofit since 1958.

shelters.name: Charlottesville-Albemarle SPCA
shelters.description: Offers Fido Field Trips program and features free-roaming cat rooms. Serves Charlottesville and Albemarle County.

shelters.name: Richmond Animal League
shelters.description: Area's oldest non-profit no-kill organization founded in 1979. Provides care to over 1,700 companion animals yearly.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Northern Virginia
shelters.description: Powered by Advocates for Abused and Abandoned Pets (A3P), 501(c)(3) charitable animal rescue organization.

shelters.name: Virginia Beach Animal Care and Adoption Center
shelters.description: Organization devoted to helping pets and owners of Virginia Beach.

shelters.name: Henrico Humane Society
shelters.description: All-volunteer, foster-based, non-profit organization rescuing dogs and cats across Central Virginia.

shelters.name: Lucky Dog Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Nonprofit organization that provides Community Awareness and Rescue Events (CARE) in Northern Virginia.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Virginia animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Richmond SPCA (founded 1891) rescues 4,000 animals yearly. Virginia Beach SPCA serving since 1966. 80 Virginia shelters achieved no-kill in 2024. Coverage spans Richmond, Norfolk, Virginia Beach, Northern Virginia, Roanoke, and Charlottesville.
